name: DOZ INN Bistro
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to DOZ INN Bistro in Tirol!** Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of **Innsbruck**, where tradition meets modern comfort. Our cozy bistro invites you to savor the finest flavors of the Alps—from hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** and crispy **Speckknödel** to fresh mountain cheeses and craft beers brewed nearby. Whether you’re craving a quick snack or a leisurely lunch, our menu offers something for every taste. Relax in our rustic yet stylish setting, surrounded by the charm of **Tirol**’s culture. After your meal, explore the city’s vibrant streets or take a scenic hike through the stunning **Nordkette** mountains—just minutes away. At DOZ INN, we believe in good food, great company, and unforgettable moments. Come experience the warmth of **Tirol** with us! --- **Visit us | Book a table**
